Environmental Disclosures: Energy Source & Emissions Data

At Nordic Energy, we are committed to full transparency in our environmental disclosures. On this page, you’ll find detailed energy source breakdowns, greenhouse gas emissions data, and regulatory compliance reporting that reflect our dedication to sustainability and responsible energy sourcing.

By publishing our fuel mix, carbon footprint, air emissions, and renewable energy share, we ensure customers and stakeholders can make informed decisions about their energy consumption. We follow recognized frameworks and industry reporting standards to present credible environmental impact statements and support corporate climate risk disclosures.

Explore our disclosures to see how we align with clean energy goals, resource diversification, and emission reduction strategies, because accountability and clean power go hand in hand.
